760190101.text: "Proof of the Cognoscenti"? Wait... Are you talking about what Paimon thinks you're talking about...?

760190102.text: Wh—Why are you crowding around?! We're discussing something super top-secret here — a clue about Reed Miller's "Great Treasure"...

760190105.text: Hmm... fair point. In that case, let's team up! I've been struggling to scrape together enough startup money anyway.

760190106.text: One share for me, one for you... and one for the flying one. That's three shares. 500,000 Mora each.

760190108.text: *sigh* Vieri, didn't we agree this was supposed to stay between the two of us? I only told you because I trust you.

760190109.text: But 1,500,000 Mora... That's way beyond the sort of startup money I could raise on my own. I can just about scrape together 500,000...

760190110.text: And these two look like seasoned adventurers. If we team up, won't our chances of success go way up?

760190111.text: I have high hopes for you, Vieri. And if you think you've found the right people, then I'm willing to give you a shot.

760190112.text: Now, as for our flying friend here — given her... unique physique, it's only fair she receives special consideration.

760190113.text: Ooh! Is that a gift for Paimon?

760190114.text: Sort of! It's a special version of Natlan's standard Strength Tonic. We tweaked it so it works for more people — even people who fly. It's totally safe.

760190115.text: As for the price... Normally, it goes for 2,000,000 Mora. But since you're with Vieri, I'll give you the friends' rate — just 1,000,000. What do you say?

760190301.text: ...If you plan to kill me or chop me into pieces, go ahead. I won't resist.

760190302.text: #Whoa, whoa! {NICKNAME} and Paimon would never do anything like that! You just promise us you won't trick anyone else, okay?

760190303.text: Even a blockhead like Vieri... Wait, where did he slip off to? ...A—Anyway, you shouldn't take advantage of people — not even the dumb ones!

760190304.text: You're kinder than most. If I'd met more folks like you back in Sumeru... maybe I wouldn't have ended up like this.

760190306.text: Aren't you curious to find out what happened to me?

760190309.text: Sharp little thing, aren't you... *sigh* Haven't made a proper deal in ages. Maybe it's time I switched careers — better that than having the Voynich Guild on my case.

760190310.text: If you'd figured that out earlier, you wouldn't have ended up getting smacked around just now!

760190311.text: Sometimes you need a wake-up call to force a real choice. Good or bad, it gets you moving.

760190312.text: Kid, flying one, if either of you ever needs that kind of a push... come find me.

760190313.text: Uhm... Thanks and all, but Paimon hopes that won't be necessary!

760190314.text: Hidimbi leaves her piece of red satin behind and waves goodbye as she leaves...
